label: Move up the tab list
placeholder: Click and press a key combination…
description: Keybind to select the previous (upward) tab. Click this field and press the key combination you want — it records automatically. Press Esc (or wait 10s) to cancel. Supports modifiers Ctrl, Alt, Shift, Meta/Cmd (and Accel) combined with a key.

label: Move down the tab list
placeholder: Click and press a key combination…
description: Keybind to select the next (downward) tab. Click this field and press the key combination you want — it records automatically. Press Esc (or wait 10s) to cancel. Supports modifiers Ctrl, Alt, Shift, Meta/Cmd (and Accel) combined with a key.

label: Skip unloaded pinned tabs
description: When navigating, skip over pinned tabs that haven't been loaded yet (discarded or never-opened), landing on the next loaded tab instead.

label: Pause media when leaving a tab
description: When you navigate away from a tab with playing audio/video, pause it. When you navigate back, resume it — but only if this mod was the one that paused it (it stays paused if you had paused it yourself).
